# DSH BTW 0.1.0 · DSH 0.2.1-rc.2

[中文](#zh) | [English](#en)

<a id="zh"></a>

## 中文

首个版本，在主任务运行时使用 `/btw` 随时旁聊。

### 新增功能

- 输入 `/btw 问题` 直接提问，输入 `/btw` 打开主输入框上方的轻量弹窗。
- 复用主请求的上下文前缀、模型配置、工具声明与缓存关联，追加旁聊内容以利用模型服务的缓存；实际命中取决于服务端。
- 原生历史列表支持直接选择问题，带问题提问时也可打开。每个主会话在当前窗口保留最近 20 条记录，刷新后清空。
- 支持流式回答、Markdown、代码复制和继续提问。停止只取消旁聊，关闭弹窗后回答继续；旁聊不执行工具，不写入主会话。

### 其他变更

- 精确适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、Cordis 4.0.5，要求 Node.js 22.19+。
- 已在 macOS 的隔离原生 Web 客户端验证；Windows、Linux 和 Electron 桌面外壳尚未实测。

<a id="en"></a>

## English

The first release adds `/btw` side questions while your main task keeps running.

### New Features

- Enter `/btw your question` to ask directly, or `/btw` to open the compact popover above the main composer.
- Preserves the main request's context prefix, model configuration, tool declarations and cache affinity, then appends side exchanges for provider cache reuse. Actual hits depend on the provider.
- A native history menu selects previous questions, including when opened with a question. Each main conversation keeps its latest 20 side exchanges in the current window; reloading clears them.
- Streaming answers, Markdown, code copying and follow-up questions. Stop cancels only the side request; closing the popover lets it continue. Side requests never execute tools or write to the main conversation.

### Other Changes

- Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and Cordis 4.0.5; requires Node.js 22.19+.
- Validated in an isolated native Web client on macOS. Windows, Linux and the Electron desktop shell have not been tested.

## 安装 / Installation

仅适用于 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**。打开 **插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴以下地址。保留现有 profile、配置和数据，任务结束后重启对应实例。

For **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2** only. Open **Plugins → Add Plugin** and paste this URL. Keep your existing profile, configuration and data; restart the instance after active tasks finish.

```text
https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/releases/download/v0.1.0-dsh.0.2.1-rc.2/gulagala001-dsh-btw-0.1.0-dsh.0.2.1-rc.2.tgz
```

[中文安装指南](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/blob/main/docs/install.zh.md) · [Installation guide](https://github.com/gulagala001/dsh-btw/blob/main/docs/install.md)
